assumptions: Only one live process owns the state directory; each predecessor exits before its successor opens storage.
Each completed persistence operation is atomic; crash cuts are at observed await boundaries.
Lost in-flight work is interrupted/unknown, not implicitly replayed; unexpired approval pauses are recoverable.
External effects without saved results are unconfirmed; no external exactly-once guarantee.
exclusions: power loss, corrupt storage or schema migration
simultaneous process writers
Bot queue and independent scheduler recovery protocols
live upstreams, arbitrary tool effects and UI
unbounded restarts, retries and approvals

mapping.step: Production startup, persistence, writer claims and graceful shutdown (HTTP drain not exercised)
Default assembly, kernel resume/retry/outcomes, writer surface and prepared model view
Model, OS process fixture, real source mutation, checker, gates and acceptance tests

runtime.engine: sequential OS processes / RawAgentRuntime production startup+destroy / SQLite / agent-loop

assumptions: One writer; synchronous append of a message is indivisible; no callback re-entry into persistence.
The model starts after two distinct call ids are recorded in one wave; all enabled event orders are explored.
Success, failure, unknown-tool and rejection abstract arbitrary payloads; retry occurs before persistence.
Cancellation closes outstanding calls; a normal end requires all calls settled; no liveness claim.
The design model specifies deduplication even within a returned batch; source probes independently check that promise.
exclusions: process kill, power loss, storage corruption
multiple writers and external side effects
unbounded calls/retries
full kernel, database, network and UI execution; source probes cover the mapped component boundary
